By Weyl's criterion, this is equivalent to: for all $k \neq 0$, $\sup_M \left|\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=M}^{M+N} e^{2\pi i k x_n}\right| \to 0$.

This is the "well-distribution" of $\{\lfloor n^{3/2} \rfloor \alpha\}$ mod 1.
